admission.justification: Combining immutable Lean/DAG models, hardened closed-world parsing, provenance-preserving stub emission, 8-stage map validation, bounded nearest-landmark import projection and atomic CLI emission guarantees reproducible, zero-partial-write 8-stage skeleton and DAG artifacts without executing Lean.

guarantee: Invoking rh-extract against read-only upstream checkouts validates the 8-stage 41-landmark condensed map, parses all mapped Lean 4 files under a hardened closed-world grammar, projects nearest-landmark import dependencies strictly through unmapped src/ and root Lean headers, and atomically emits byte-identical provenance-preserving skeleton files and an acyclic proof DAG without executing Lean or leaving partial writes on error.
title: Phase 1 deterministic Lean 4 extractor, 8-stage map and nearest-landmark DAG pipeline
